report_identity.report_title: China Electronics Huada Technology Company Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The group designs and sells integrated circuit chips, mainly in Mainland China.

segments.name: Integrated circuit products and services
segments.business_substance: Sale of integrated circuit products and provision of services; managed as a single segment.

business_overview.revenue_model: Product sales and services recognised when product control transfers to customers; most revenue is goods sales.
business_notes: Nearly 100% of revenue is attributable to Mainland China and over 90% of non-current assets are located in Mainland China.
Three external customers each contributed more than 10% of revenue in 2025.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Interest income on cash/deposits and guarantee deposits; not treated as operating chip business cash profit after detachable cash analysis.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow covers reported profit in 2023 and 2025 but 2024 was weak. 2025 free cash flow after capex was supported by working-capital release; reported profit also includes government grants, interest income and inventory provision reversal. Owner-earnings denominator therefore uses a discounted operating cash profit rather than reported net profit.

evidence.note: All annual fact amounts are in HK$'000 unless otherwise stated.

evidence.value: Nearly 100% revenue from Mainland China; over 90% non-current assets in Mainland China

evidence.note: Cash and deposits with CEC and companies under common control.
All due within one year, RMB-denominated, unsecured, fixed rate.

gaps: Annual report does not split bank time deposits by remaining maturity between 3-12 months and over 1 year.
Annual report does not disclose parent-level distributable cash beyond the company-only balance sheet; PRC subsidiary dividend friction must be estimated.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed.
Working-capital reinvestment cannot be normalised precisely from one current annual report; 2023-2025 cash-flow data are used as a check.
